environment.description: Same application deployed identically but with AWS WAF WebACL associated to the ALB. The WebACL contains a single rule group reference: a custom rule group (priority 1, capacity 200) with a single RegexPatternSet-based rule. The rule inspects the 'value' query string parameter using a SizeConstraint (field: QUERY_STRING, comparison: GT, size: 64) combined with a RegexPatternSetReferenceStatement matching body content against pattern `(?i)(?:--|;|'|/\*|\*/|union|select|insert|update|delete|drop|exec|xp_|0x[0-9a-f])` applied to SingleQueryArgument 'value'. Action: BLOCK. Additionally, a second rule (priority 2) uses a SqliMatchStatement with field_to_match set to AllQueryArguments and text_transformation NONE plus URL_DECODE plus HTML_ENTITY_DECODE, action BLOCK. The WebACL default action is ALLOW.
